text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Seeking the Pearl, at your
service!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The whole world is my oyster... And I'm
going to
prove it on the track, so get
your hopes up high
for me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna inspire the grandest dreams in

everyone! Now—let's embark for the
stage of
infinite possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
